reason: Decided mainly on the packet; one web search for late-Nov 2026 outlook returned only stale material (a Sept Fed hike, late-Oct tests), so no new catalyst found. Re-entering after a +5.6% one-week rebound into a still-hawkish Fed would mean chasing and paying round-trip costs on a book that keeps getting stopped, while cash earns 4%. Keep INDA and wait for a pullback or a clearer setup.
